# Execute the original tests without waiting for unrelated 180-minute campaigns.
# Test budgets, workloads and service lifetime remain defined by the unchanged Rust source.
"name": "PoN original large-state CPU acceptance"
"on":
  "pull_request": {}
"permissions":
  "contents": "read"
"concurrency":
  "group": "pon-original-large-state-${{ github.ref }}"
  "cancel-in-progress": false
"env":
  "CI": "true"
  "CARGO_INCREMENTAL": "0"
  "CARGO_BUILD_JOBS": "2"
  "RUST_TEST_THREADS": "1"
  "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1"
"jobs":
  "original-state-and-exit":
    "name": "original state and exit (${{ matrix.runner }}, ${{ matrix.source }})"
    "runs-on": "${{ matrix.runner }}"
    "timeout-minutes": 60
    "strategy":
      "fail-fast": false
      "matrix":
        "runner":
          - "ubuntu-24.04"
          - "ubuntu-24.04-arm"
        "source":
          - "head"
          - "prospective-merge"
    "env":
      "EXPECTED_HEAD": "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}"
      "EXPECTED_BASE": "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}"
      "EXPECTED_MERGE": "${{ github.sha }}"
      "SOURCE_KIND": "${{ matrix.source }}"
    "steps":
      -
        "name": "Checkout the exact candidate or actual target merge"
        "uses": "actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262"
        "with":
          "ref": "${{ matrix.source == 'head' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}"
          "fetch-depth": 0
          "persist-credentials": false
      -
        "name": "Verify unchanged source and original project boundary"
        "id": "source"
        "shell": "bash"
        "run": |-
          set -euo pipefail
          export TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/original-large-state-observations"
          mkdir -p "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR"
          printf 'TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR=%s\n' "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_HOME=%s/cargo-original-large-state\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/target-original-large-state\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD")
          if [ "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge ]; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$EXPECTED_BASE" --expected-merge "$EXPECTED_MERGE")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/source-before.json"
          bash scripts/project-preflight.sh --audit
      -
        "name": "Install the source-pinned native toolchain"
        "id": "toolchain"
        "run": "rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy"
      -
        "name": "Build the unchanged default release test binary"
        "id": "build"
        "shell": "bash"
        "run": |-
          set -euo pipefail
          rustc +1.95.0 -Vv > "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/rustc.txt"
          cargo +1.95.0 -V > "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/cargo.txt"
          uname -a > "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/host.txt"
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          root = Path(os.environ["TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR"])
          keys = ("CI", "CARGO_HOME", "CARGO_TARGET_DIR", "CARGO_BUILD_JOBS", "CARGO_INCREMENTAL",
                  "RUST_TEST_THREADS", "RUSTFLAGS", "CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS", "RUSTC_WRAPPER",
                  "RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER", "RUSTC", "CARGO_BUILD_RUSTC", "CARGO_BUILD_RUSTFLAGS",
                  "CARGO_BUILD_TARGET", "CARGO_BUILD_RUSTC_WRAPPER", "CARGO_BUILD_RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER")
          env = {key: os.environ.get(key) for key in keys}
          env.update({key: value for key, value in os.environ.items()
                      if key.startswith("CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_") or
                      (key.startswith("CARGO_TARGET_") and key.endswith("_RUSTFLAGS"))})
          command = ["cargo", "+1.95.0", "test", "--release", "--locked", "--manifest-path",
                     "trillionnium/Cargo.toml", "-p", "trnm-pon-node", "--lib", "--no-run", "--message-format=json"]
          (root / "build-command.json").write_text(json.dumps({"argv": command, "environment": env}, indent=2) + "\n")
          overrides = keys[6:]
          assert not any(env.get(key) for key in overrides), "unexpected compiler override"
          assert not any(value for key, value in env.items() if key.startswith("CARGO_TARGET_")
                         and key.endswith("_RUSTFLAGS")), "unexpected target compiler flags"
          assert not any(key.startswith("CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_") for key in env), "unexpected release profile override"
          PY
          cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib --no-run --message-format=json > "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/build.jsonl" 2> "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/build.stderr"
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          root = Path(os.environ["TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR"])
          rows = [json.loads(line) for line in (root / "build.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
          finished = [row for row in rows if row.get("reason") == "build-finished"]
          assert len(finished) == 1 and finished[0]["success"] is True
          artifacts = [row for row in rows if row.get("reason") == "compiler-artifact"
                       and row.get("target", {}).get("name") == "trnm_pon_node"
                       and row.get("profile", {}).get("test") is True and row.get("executable")]
          assert len(artifacts) == 1
          artifact = artifacts[0]
          assert artifact["target"]["kind"] == ["lib"]
          binary = Path(artifact["executable"])
          assert binary.is_absolute() and binary.is_file() and not binary.is_symlink()
          profile = artifact["profile"]
          assert profile["opt_level"] == "3" and profile["debug_assertions"] is False and profile["overflow_checks"] is False
          assert artifact["features"] == ["default"], "expected default features"
          with binary.open("rb") as stream:
              assert stream.read(4) == b"\x7fELF"
              stream.seek(0)
              digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
          (root / "binary.json").write_text(json.dumps({"artifact": artifact, "sha256": digest,
              "scope": "original standalone CPU-policy tests and native reactor-exit regressions"}, indent=2) + "\n")
          (root / "binary.sha256").write_text(digest + "  " + str(binary) + "\n")
          (root / "binary.txt").write_text(str(binary) + "\n")
          PY
      -
        "name": "Run both original CPU budgets and actual reactor-exit regressions"
        "if": "${{ !cancelled() && steps.source.outcome == 'success' && steps.toolchain.outcome == 'success' && steps.build.outcome == 'success' }}"
        "shell": "bash"
        "run": |-
          set -euo pipefail
          binary="$(cat "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/binary.txt")"
          sha256sum -c "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/binary.sha256"
          cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node"
          pwd > "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/test-cwd.txt"
          status=0
          printf 'selector\tnative_exit\tlog_exit\treader_exit\n' > "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/test-exits.tsv"
          for selector in \
            store::detached_admission::tests::admitted_custom_genesis_over_eight_mib_keeps_original_held_schedule_and_cpu_owner \
            store::detached_admission::tests::authenticated_large_parent_original_schedule_supplementary_denominator \
            ingress::public_v2::tests::public_loop_exit_records_lifetime_before_internal_stop \
            ingress::public_v2::tests::public_loop_exit_records_external_stop_after_signed_read; do
            name="${selector##*::}"
            log="$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/$name.log"
            set +e
            /usr/bin/time -v -o "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/$name.resources.txt" "$binary" "$selector" --exact --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$log"
            codes=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
            python3 "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py" "$log" --test "$selector" > "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/$name.execution.json" 2> "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/$name.execution.stderr"
            reader=$?
            set -e
            printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$selector" "${codes[0]}" "${codes[1]}" "$reader" >> "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/test-exits.tsv"
            if [ "${codes[0]}" -ne 0 ] || [ "${codes[1]}" -ne 0 ] || [ "$reader" -ne 0 ]; then
              status=1
            fi
          done
          sha256sum -c "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/binary.sha256"
          exit "$status"
      -
        "name": "Reverify exact source after every outcome"
        "if": "always()"
        "shell": "bash"
        "run": |-
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD")
          if [ "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge ]; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$EXPECTED_BASE" --expected-merge "$EXPECTED_MERGE")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/original-large-state-observations/source-after.json"
      -
        "name": "Retain actual successes and failures"
        "if": "always()"
        "uses": "actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02"
        "with":
          "name": "original-large-state-${{ matrix.runner }}-${{ matrix.source }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}"
          "path": "${{ runner.temp }}/original-large-state-observations/"
          "if-no-files-found": "error"
          "retention-days": 30
